units.content: Code states its purpose is a stable representation layer for empirical/computational experiments, not a complete adaptive-system simulation.
Implements Scale enum MICRO, MESO, MACRO, CIVILIZATIONAL and docstring assertion that scale is orthogonal to adaptive depth.
Implements AdaptiveDepth enum D0_STATE through D3_GENERATOR_DYNAMICS.
Implements InternalConfiguration fields Z,M,policy,value_function,capability,search_mechanism,generator_mechanism,resources.
Implements Trajectory histories for state, capability, generator and omega.
Implements AdaptiveSystem structural container, state_vector and describe methods.
state_transition intentionally raises NotImplementedError and instructs domain-specific implementations; no domain dynamics are implemented here.
Direct run constructs a MICRO/D2 example with capability/resources and prints describe(); this is programmed example behavior, not execution record or result.
Causal-identification layer intended to attribute capability acceleration to generator dynamics rather than resources/ordinary improvement; source says goal is attribution, not correlation.
Implements Intervention, CausalObservation, GrowthDecomposition, ConfoundAssessment, PhaseOrdering, SystemComparison and FalsificationResult data structures.
Implements simple delta() and log reachable_growth() estimators with zero returns for invalid/degenerate inputs.
Implements generator_effect as Delta C / Delta G_m with zero when Delta G_m is zero.
Implements estimate_omega as change in efficiency divided by dt; zero for nonpositive dt.
generator_dominant uses absolute component share > threshold default 0.5; this threshold is implementation choice, not validated causal criterion.
PhaseOrdering.supported returns t_generator < t_omega < t_capability.
causal_prediction treats resource/capability differences <0.1 as controls and records whether omega_a>omega_b; fixed 0.1 tolerance is implementation assumption.
evaluate_case thresholds delta_gm, delta_omega, delta_c at >0 and marks resource_explanation when delta_r>delta_gm; framework_supported is a programmed Boolean conjunction.
Direct-run hard-coded example prints labels 'Temporal prediction' and 'Framework supported'; no frozen run output is present, so labels/results are not scientific support.
Generator Dynamics measurement layer; estimates whether system became better at improving capability-generation process, explicitly not intelligence measurement.
GeneratorMetrics implements iteration-cost reduction, approach expansion, representation compression, reusable infrastructure and improvement automation.
GeneratorTransition computes componentwise change and Euclidean magnitude as scalar approximation |Delta G_m|.
GeneratorState stores name/domain/mechanisms plus proxy metrics; docstring says G_m is process/operator, not scalar capability.
Implements normalized estimators for iteration gain, representation compression, reusable infrastructure, approach expansion and improvement automation.
generator_score computes weighted scalar sum, default equal weights; code explicitly says this is only empirical estimator, not definition of G_m.
detect_generator_transition uses magnitude > threshold default 0.1; threshold is implementation choice.
GeneratorEvent implements dataset-compatible historical event with before/after GeneratorState and optional year.
Direct-run compiler example supplies manually chosen proxy values 0.8,0.7,0.9,0.8,0.6; these are synthetic/example inputs, not observations.
Direct-run prints 'Generator change' from example inputs; no frozen execution record makes this a reported result.
Evolutionary Velocity measurement layer; distinguishes total reachable-space expansion, resource/capability/generator components, and Omega as measured evolutionary contribution.
ReachableState stores timestamp, reachable_size, capability, generator_score and resources; docstring calls it empirical proxy because true P_reach cannot be enumerated.
log_growth_rate computes log reachable-size growth rate with zero for nonpositive previous space or dt.
ExpansionComponents/decompose_expansion store resource, capability and generator causal-attribution estimates; code notes values would come from experimental identification.
OmegaMeasurement estimates (Delta C/Delta G_m)/Delta t with zero on zero denominator; its docstring calls this approximation Omega_hat.
OmegaTracker stores measurements and computes current/trend differences.
PhaseBoundarySignal.detected requires generator_change, omega_change and capability_change all above configurable threshold default 0.
omega_residual estimates Omega as total growth minus resource and capability growth when direct generator attribution unavailable.
compare_systems labels prediction_supported when higher omega and higher future capability co-occur; does not establish causality.
Direct run uses hard-coded Delta C=100, Delta generator=10, dt=5 and boundary changes 0.8/0.5/1.2, printing Omega estimate and phase-boundary detection; no run artifact present.
Reachable-space geometry layer; defines accessible future transformations under constraints and explicitly does not enumerate all possible futures.
Transformation immutable dataclass stores name/source/target/cost/metadata and distinguishes transition from state.
ReachabilityConstraints stores representation, policy, value function, capability, search/generator mechanisms and resources.
ReachableSpace stores a set of transformations and optional constraints; size/add/contains implement finite proxy operations.
reachable_expansion computes set difference and capability(space) returns finite set size as current-capability approximation.
frontier_distance implements simple symmetric Jaccard-style distance; source says future versions may use KL, graph, Wasserstein or manifold distance.
explore_reachable_space applies provided search operator; modify_reachability_generator delegates to generator operator.
log_reachability_velocity approximates d/dt log|P_reach| using finite set sizes.
Direct run creates two example transformations and prints 'Reachable capability'; no frozen execution output is present.
